data.body: AC amendment (gap-analysis: state_file_conflict): DEFER ticket idempotency query must handle (1) ticket-list pagination: use --format=llm or --limit=0 (unbounded) to ensure no real duplicate is hidden beyond page boundary; (2) just-created ticket index propagation lag: on Finding-Hash collision, query specific ticket by ID to confirm status != 'deleted' before treating as duplicate; (3) creation race: if two arbiter runs both create a ticket with the same Finding-Hash+Scope, second one to detect duplicate during post-create verification must self-delete via 'dso ticket delete <id> --user-approved' with reason 'arbiter-dedup race loser'. Add test_arbiter_processor_defer_race_loser_self_deletes.
